title: gladiolus segetum subsp. bornetii
intro: Gladiolus segetum subsp. bornetii, commonly known as Wild Gladiolus or Autumn Crocus, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammatory conditions and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Wild Gladiolus include colchicine, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds such as alkaloids and glycosides that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
